name: Rift brute
description: a hulking squat brute that climbed up out of the Rift's magma: a lumpy body of molten rock under a cooled black crust, cracks glowing orange, huge long arms with heavy rock fists dragging on the ground, short legs, a small head sunk between its shoulders with two glowing eyes, steam rising off it

poses.stand: standing hunched on short legs, huge rock fists hanging to the ground
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: stands hunched, breathing steam, cracks pulsing

move.action: lumbers forward on its short legs, knuckles dragging, staying in the same spot in the frame

attack.action: swings a huge rock fist forward in a heavy punch to the right, then drags it back

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
